maudhui: (1) Every person is entitled to own property, and has a right to the protection of his property held in accordance with the law. (2) Subject to the provisions of subarticle (1), it shall be unlawful for any person to be deprived of his property for the purposes of nationalization or any other purposes without the authority of law which makes provision for fair and adequate compensation.
